title: Concept: SQL built by concatenation (elixir) — review required
description: In elixir, (?:Ecto.Adapters.SQL|Repo).query!?s*([^)]*<> mixes code and data in one SQL string. Concatenation is the classic injection primitive: quotes and keywords in the input rewrite the statement. The remedy is bound parameters via parameter placeholders ($1) with a bound list.
applicability: elixir codebases issuing SQL through the flagged call; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Full database compromise (read, write, execute) when untrusted input reaches the query; HIGH severity.
